pure-announcement.rationale: It introduces a specification whose conventions are themselves the content — path-as-identity markdown concepts, a single required frontmatter field, links-as-graph — which is coverage of a technique, not a version release.

duplicate.rationale: The existing llm-maintained-wiki concept covers the underlying pattern but not this note's new material: a vendor-neutral spec, its concrete conventions, and the interoperability argument that bespoke wiki instances cannot exchange bundles.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The Google Cloud primary source is linked and the spec is described concretely enough to parse with the included ten-line consumer.

durability.rationale: Like the llms.txt exemplar, this is a just-proposed v0.1 vendor convention with reference tools but no committed consumers, so its standing in twelve months depends entirely on adoption that has not happened.

actionability.rationale: A team can adopt the conventions today with no product dependency — the note gives the directory shape, reserved frontmatter fields, and a working parser, plus concrete uses like metadata-as-code and agent runbooks.

atomicity.rationale: Everything serves one statable idea: standardize curated agent context as a bundle of cross-linked markdown-plus-frontmatter concept files.
